verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair axis for an online IP-filing and search service, so it applies. Nothing in the pack shows a natural-language, chatbot or conversational interface for filing, searching or managing IP titles. The docs describe conventional online filing procedures, database search and human expert support, and the probe shows only a token-gated data portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
